notes:
SafeStore now catches backup files that look complete but cannot actually be read, and Salvage no longer looks stuck on a long hole.

- If a backup file cannot be read, you will see Backup file unreadable — plug the SD back in and tap Fix backup. Do not format that card
- Salvage is quicker when it hits a damaged stretch on the Hub
- Settings may mention the backup drive's health. USB docks often hide that report — backups still run
- How footage is copied and uploaded on a healthy wedding is unchanged
